basic_details.job_title: IIT Kanpur Project Executive Officer (Research and Development) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Office of the Dean of Research and Development, Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur, has invited applications for two Project Executive Officer posts on a purely temporary and contractual basis for one year, which may be extended based on requirement. The consolidated pay is INR 71400/- (50400-4200-126000), depending on prior experience. Candidates need a Master of Law (L.L.M.) or a Bachelor of Law with at least 60% marks plus 5 years of relevant experience. Resumes must be emailed to [email protected] so that they are received by 20 November 2026 (5:30 PM).

vacancy_details.details: The notice gives two positions for the post of Project Executive Officer. It prints no category-wise break-up.

how_to_apply: Send a detailed resume to [email protected].
Write the mail subject as "Application for the post of Project Executive Officer" and follow this subject strictly.
Show in the resume the percentage (%) marks for 10th, 12th, UG and PG.
Show national/state level exam details (NET etc.) and relevant academic/industry work experience, if any.
Attach all educational documents and experience certificates with the resume.
Make sure the application is received by 20 November 2026 (5:30 PM).
The notice also asks candidates to apply on the Google Form link given in it (see Important Links). In the absence of the resume details listed above, the application will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: IIT Kanpur Project Executive Officer at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice gives two positions for the post of Project Executive Officer. It prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Relevant experience in business laws, including formulating agreements and negotiations. Work experience in IPR, international laws pertaining to design and Inventions. Master's degree with specialization in Business Law. Work experience in R&D labs, industries and academia in the above fields.

rows.essential_qualification: Master of law (L.L.M.) OR Bachelor of Law with at least 60% marks from a University/ College recognised by the Bar Council of India + 5 years relevant experience

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The salary is INR 71400/- consolidated, with the scale given as 50400-4200-126000, depending on prior experience. The engagement is purely temporary and contractual for one year, and the period may be extended based on requirement. Selected candidates are expected to join at the earliest.

content_sections.heading: IIT Kanpur Project Executive Officer Job Description
content_sections.text: The person will be responsible for the following activities: Drafting/ vetting of MoUs/ Agreements related to research, collaboration, non-disclosure, CSR funding and agreements for academic activities. Technology transfer activities. Negotiations with industries related to intellectual property related matters. Liasoning with corporate sector for R&D activities.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kanpur Project Executive Officer
content_sections.text: Send a detailed resume to [email protected] . Write the mail subject as "Application for the post of Project Executive Officer" and follow this subject strictly. Show in the resume the percentage (%) marks for 10th, 12th, UG and PG. Show national/state level exam details (NET etc.) and relevant academic/industry work experience, if any. Attach all educational documents and experience certificates with the resume. Make sure the application is received by 20 November 2026 (5:30 PM). The notice also asks candidates to apply on the Google Form link given in it (see Important Links). In the absence of the resume details listed above, the application will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed by emails. The notice mentions an interview but does not describe its mode or date. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Executive Officer posts has IIT Kanpur announced?
faq.answer: The notice announces two (02) positions for the post of Project Executive Officer in the Office of the Dean of Research and Development.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications is 20 November 2026 (5:30 PM).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master of law (L.L.M.) OR a Bachelor of Law with at least 60% marks from a University/ College recognised by the Bar Council of India, plus 5 years relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the Project Executive Officer?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is INR 71400/- (50400-4200-126000), depending on prior experience.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email a detailed resume to [email protected] with the subject "Application for the post of Project Executive Officer", attaching all educational documents and experience certificates. The notice also gives a Google Form link.

faq.question: Q6. What must the resume contain?
faq.answer: It must contain the percentage marks for 10th, 12th, UG and PG, national/state level exam details (NET etc.) if any, and relevant academic/industry work experience, if any. Without these details the application will not be considered.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary and contractual for one year, and the period may be extended based on requirement.

faq.question: Q8. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. How will shortlisted candidates be informed?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be informed by emails.
